==Hero Usage==
* Heroes will sometimes use this skill on an ally that just got knocked down, but not always (often other skills will take priority) and not preventing the knockdown when doing so. They will try to use it preemptively on an ally that has a skill that knocks down the user.

==Notes==
* Works with self inflicted knock down (i.e. [[Grapple]], [[Desperation Blow]], and [[Drunken Blow]]).
* If a single effect knocks down the affected ally multiple times (e.g. hitting multiple enemies with the skills above using a [[scythe]]), the shout will inflict its damage, but will not prevent the ally from being knocked down.
* Damage is inflicted even if the knock down would be prevented by other effects, such as [["I Am Unstoppable!"]] or [[Balanced Stance]].
